title: A giant recycled table brings thousands together
summary:
How long can a dinner table be? In Bucharest, Romania, one stretched for 3.1 miles, or 4.99 kilometers!

About 20,000 people gathered for a community meal at the Uniting Table on September 12, 2026. It earned a Guinness World Record for the longest table made from recycled materials. Recycled materials have been used before and are put to use again.

The nonprofit group Bloom The World organized the event. A nonprofit works toward a cause instead of sharing profits with owners. This meal raised more than $110,000 for Romania's first psychiatric hospital for children. Such a hospital provides specialist care for mental health and related needs.

The new hospital is planned to open in 2027. Children needing mental health care in Bucharest currently use an outdated building with crowded wards and little privacy.

Bloom also set this record in 2025, with a shorter table in Alba Iulia, Romania.

The latest table's journey is not finished. Bloom plans to recycle its materials again, turning them into furniture for children.
why_it_matters: The meal brought people together and raised money for children's care. The table's materials are also planned to become children's furniture.
